governance: Shared dictionary of governed context keys — the same concept uses the same key in every app. Agents READ this file; only humans WRITE it. Extra app-specific keys are allowed (context is semi-open) but must be snake_case, flat, primitive-valued. Recurring un-governed concepts get proposed to the human, same flow as taxonomy rule R3.
value_conventions: Values for action, milestone, and target are snake_case, verb- or outcome-based, and generic over app-specific (quiz_passed, not safety101_quiz_passed — the app is identified by app_id).

keys.feature: name of the feature emitting the event (snake_case)
keys.proposed_type: R3 fallback — proposed new event type
